comments: I guess the compiler may have done some optimization that leads to this error? Or the kernel's problem?

My first reaction looking at this test is that I don't understand why this has condition has to be true. 

EDIT: Ah, ok. Looks like this is cumulative. In which case, I don't understand why it's not true on your environment.

> My first reaction looking at this test is that I don't understand why this has condition has to be true.
> 
> EDIT: Ah, ok. Looks like this is cumulative. In which case, I don't understand why it's not true on your environment.

I don’t know either.:( But with the patch above, this problem will never occur again.
I don't think we want that patch. We really want to figure out the reason for this, instead of a patch to cover up the issues.

It's still puzzling to me how cpu aggregated time can go back in your case. As you suspected, this could be a combination of Linux Kernel and ARM issue. Although I couldn't find the authoritative source saying that this cpu time should be monotonic, I think there is nothing we can do about it until we have clear evidence that there is a problem with the test code.

I will continuely work on this problem. But I will use the patch above to workaorund for the following release. 
Thanks a lot.

> It's still puzzling to me how cpu aggregated time can go back in your case. As you suspected, this could be a combination of Linux Kernel and ARM issue. Although I couldn't find the authoritative source saying that this cpu time should be monotonic, I think there is nothing we can do about it until we have clear evidence that there is a problem with the test code.

I read the kernel code and the time is all `+=`, so it should be monotonic, I think.

This problem occurs when kernel enables `CONFIG_CONTEXT_TRACKING_FORCE` and `CONFIG_VIRT_CPU_ACCOUNTING_GEN`.I am sure it's an upstream kernel issue. We will report and fix this soon.
Thanks a lot.

https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/d41afbd5-6040-50ec-c0a5-c52ae48f6515@huawei.com/
This problem has been fix in newest upstream kernel. 
Close the issue.
